havainnekuva.prompt: Create one original 16:9 painterly concept image for Matkakirja game lens D5, Birth of Nation States in Europe 1830–1918. Wide antique Europe map, warm cream parchment on explorer desk. Six luminous historical milestones in Belgium, Italy, Germany, Bulgaria, Norway, and Finland, connected in a subtle chronological arc; use gentle localized watercolor washes and fine map-boundary lines that suggest changing sovereignties without modern borders or big flags. A delicate brass clock timeline along bottom edge with six empty tick positions. Elegant historical ink cartography, subtle vignette, restrained gold light, readable peninsula and northern geography. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, buttons, UI, people or modern buildings. Unique composition. High-resolution PNG.
